What is wrong with the source data before I trust any figure above?
A fund is recorded as a holder of its own SPV code (treasury / self-class). Excluded from the ownership math so it can't distort percentages, but flagged as a mapping/setup artifact to review.
Two or more funds own each other in a loop. The engine resolves it by fixed-point so totals still reconcile, but a circular holding is a structural/data red flag that should be confirmed.
A holding maps (via SPV Fund Code) to an entity that has no positions anywhere in the file. The look-through dead-ends — likely a missing feed or an incorrect SPV code.

An intra-group holding is flagged to be eliminated on look-through (double-count = Y), but the target entity has no underlying positions to look through to (e.g. an opco shell). Its value can't be decomposed.
An entity is referenced but has no VPM symbol and/or no name, so it can't be identified cleanly in downstream systems. A naming/reference-data gap.
